name: Turso
subtitle: Hosted SQLite (libSQL) at the edge
creator: Glauber Costa and Pekka Enberg (ChiselStrike)
license: libSQL is MIT; cloud is proprietary
description: A hosted database built on libSQL, an open fork of SQLite. It can replicate databases close to users and embed read replicas inside your app, and it makes a database-per-user design cheap.
useCases: Edge and serverless apps that want SQLite

concepts.explanation: A local copy that syncs from the cloud.

codeSamples.label: TypeScript

pricing.summary: Free tier; Developer plan $4.99/mo; higher usage-based plans.
